description: Sequential switch sending one input to one of four outputs, stepped by a clock or crossfaded by CV

inputs.text: The signal sent out to the four outputs
A rising edge sets the switch back to the first output; the voltage is divided by five before the comparison, so it has to rise above 7.5V
A rising edge advances the switch to the next output, wrapping round after the fourth; the voltage is divided by five before the comparison, so it has to rise above 7.5V
Patching anything here turns off stepping and crossfades instead, 0V putting the signal on the first output and 5V on the fourth

outputs.text: Carries the input while the switch is on that output and 0V otherwise, or its share of the crossfade while the CV jack is patched

notes: With the CV jack patched, the clock and reset no longer move the switch; the crossfade takes over for as long as a cable is in CV.
The clock and reset jacks need more than 7.5V to register, so a 5V gate will not drive this module.

inputs.1: high above 7.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 7.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3:
0 to 5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
